name: @pipeworx/mcp-lorem

tools.name: generate_paragraphs
tools.description: Generate placeholder text paragraphs for mockups and layout testing. Returns plain text without formatting.

length.description: Length of each paragraph: short, medium, long, or verylong

tools.name: generate_with_options
tools.description: Generate formatted placeholder text with headers, code blocks, and lists (HTML). Specify which elements to include: headers, code blocks, unordered lists, ordered lists.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-lorem forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the lorem pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
